title: TensorPlate Memory Budget Breakdown
description: Canonical memory budget line-item vocabulary shared by every model class. A deployable declares the lines relevant to its class; lines not declared default to zero, and unknown line names are rejected. Whether a specific line must be non-zero is a row/bundle admission rule, not a vocabulary rule. Line values are integers in [0, 2^53) — the exactly-representable IEEE-754 double range, so a declared byte count can never be silently rounded to a different integer by a JSON parser; per the JSON data model, numbers with a zero fractional part (e.g. 4096.0) are integers. This schema versions independently of the cross-process protocol; consumers reject other schema_version values as static-config errors. This document defines names and record semantics only; bundle-field integration and runtime admission are owned elsewhere.

model_weights_bytes.description: Resident weights for this deployment (per variant where variants are full checkpoints).

runtime_overhead_bytes.description: Framework/runtime fixed overhead (CUDA context, torch runtime, CT2 runtime, engine runtime).

cache_bytes.description: Reusable cache state: KV/token cache, tokenizer/decoder cache, or an engine-managed KV pool on delegated rows.

step_scratch_bytes.description: Iterative-step scratch: flow/denoising steps, beam state beyond per-session state where applicable.

output_queue_bytes.description: Queued outputs awaiting delivery: action queue, undelivered stream events.

io_buffer_bytes.description: Ingress/egress buffers: frames, audio chunks, preallocated fixed-shape outputs.

per_session_state_bytes.description: Marginal cost of one live streaming session (multiplied by the session ceiling in ledger admission).

sidecar_process_bytes.description: Sidecar process footprint (RSS bound) where the backend path uses one.

os_reserve_bytes.description: OS/system reserve for the platform profile.

backend_reserve_bytes.description: Backend-specific reserve (allocator slack, engine internals not covered by other lines).
